name: Children Obeying Their Parents
overview: Scripture clearly commands children to honor and obey their parents as a reflection of their obedience to God, promising blessings and long life for those who do so, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Deuteronomy 5:16. The seriousness of this duty is further emphasized by the severe consequences for rebellion, highlighted in Exodus 21:15 and Deuteronomy 21:18. Wisdom is linked to heeding parental instruction, with Proverbs affirming that a wise son listens to his father's guidance and values his mother's teaching, contrasting the folly of rejecting correction.
